Reference / runtime/binary

runtime/binary#

The native layer under encoding/binary, http/internal/websocket_frame: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under encoding/binary, http/internal/websocket_frame: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable fixed-width numeric binary boundary. Integers use unsigned magnitude or two's complement. Floats use finite IEEE 754 binary32/binary64.

native binary_masked_slice#

native binary_masked_slice(origin is @byte, mask is @byte, offset is int, start is int, size is int) is @byte

Exact stringwise repeated four-octet mask, bounded to 65536 output bytes. Offset is the phase at origin[0]; start advances that phase. No input consumed.
